source_title: Focused Update to ICU PADIS Guidelines
clinical_context: Use when summarizing sedation status or explaining why sedation choices need clinician oversight.
key_points: The PADIS update issued a conditional recommendation favoring dexmedetomidine over propofol in selected mechanically ventilated adults when light sedation or delirium reduction are highest priorities.
This card must not be used to order sedatives, choose a sedative, or dose medication.
professional_summary_template: Sedation context: patient is mechanically ventilated; sedation and delirium issues require clinician interpretation.
